name: cabout_dlg_constructor
description: CAboutDlg::CAboutDlg forwards dialog resource 0x67 and the parent window to the MFC CDialog resource constructor.
known_limits: VC5 COFF byte coverage is tracked by tools/vc5_verify_targets/cabout_dlg_constructor.json; the surrounding source-block row remains provenance-unresolved because no source-path literal proves the original physical host.
The native smoke patches the smoke process MFC42 ordinal 324 import for CDialog::CDialog(UINT, CWnd*) and restores it before return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x401000 validates CDialog::CDialog(self, 0x67, parent) followed by installing g_CAboutDlg_Vtbl and returning self.

The native smoke verifies the recovered resource id 0x67, null default parent forwarding, and that the derived constructor installs a non-null CAboutDlg vtable after the patched base constructor returns.
